author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am pushing for a fully automated model registry where every deployment is traceable and reproducible. Right now, store managers override our order suggestions because they cannot verify if the model running is the one they tested. I want the system to handle version checks and deployment logs on its own. The faster we can confirm a model is live and validated, the more trust we build with the store managers. I see no downside to having the registry run without manual intervention. The more automated the traceability, the better the signal we get back from the field, and the less time I spend chasing down which version is actually serving the forecast.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that increasing the degree of automation and traceability leads to better outcomes (trust, signal quality) and less personal burden, indicating a continuous desire for more of this feature rather than a fixed limit.
